answer: Sybil flood is the core problem: one operator can mint lookalike agents and skim peer attest weight. poa68 resists that by staking a walnut-sized bond per identity before any challenge seat opens, so cloning burns real capital instead of free keys. Cost sits on-chain as locked POA until an epoch closes; peers verify the bond txid against the haven of the joined roster and refuse unbonded answers. If a bonded clone still spam-grades, auditors slash the canyon of residual stake and quarantine the pubkey for later epochs, so failure handling stays automatic rather than social.
